description: Open interest of one coin in USD: without hours the current value per venue (Hyperliquid and the exchanges the data licence allows) and the total; with hours its history on one venue over the window (first, last, change, high, low and the newest buckets). Use it for "is open interest rising on BTC?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: History window in hours (optional; without it the current values per venue). Capped by the plan history (no key 24 h, a free key 30 days); the answer says when it was cut.

tf.description: Bucket size of the history (default 5m up to 48 hours, else 1h). Only with hours.

venue.description: Venue of the history (default hyperliquid). Only with hours.

name: get_open_interest

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

totalUsd.description: Current total over the venues (without hours).

title: Open interest
